chunks.head: keep mum
chunks.note: mum 意为“不作声的”；keep mum 指对某事绝口不提、保守秘密。本章两个男孩歃血为盟就是发誓 keep mum。
chunks.ex_en: Promise me you'll keep mum about the surprise party.
chunks.ex_cn: 答应我，惊喜派对的事你要守口如瓶。

chunks.head: from time to time
chunks.note: 表示不经常、不规律地发生。

literal.note_cn: 此处为习语固定用法，无独立含义

chunks.ex_en: I still visit my old school from time to time.
chunks.ex_cn: 我还是会时不时回老学校看看。

chunks.head: catch one's breath
chunks.note: 指剧烈运动后停下来恢复呼吸；也可指因惊讶而屏住呼吸。本章为前者。
chunks.ex_en: Let me sit down and catch my breath after that run.
chunks.ex_cn: 跑完那一段，让我坐下喘口气。

chunks.head: scared to death
chunks.note: to death 在这里是夸张用法，表示程度极深。
chunks.ex_en: She was scared to death when the lights went out.
chunks.ex_cn: 灯一灭，她吓得要死。

chunks.head: prick up one's ears
chunks.gloss: 竖起耳朵；(听到动静后)留神细听
chunks.note: 原指动物竖起耳朵，引申为人突然专注地听。
chunks.ex_en: The dog pricked up its ears at the sound of footsteps.
chunks.ex_cn: 听到脚步声，那只狗竖起了耳朵。

chunks.head: take to one's heels
chunks.note: heels 指脚后跟，借指奔跑；整句意为拔腿逃跑。

literal.note_cn: 此处为习语用法，指开始（奔跑）

chunks.ex_en: When the thief saw the police, he took to his heels.
chunks.ex_cn: 小偷一看见警察，撒腿就跑。

chunks.head: break the camel's back
chunks.gloss: (最后一击)使人再也承受不住；压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草
chunks.note: 出自谚语“最后一根稻草压垮骆驼”，指微不足道的额外负担导致彻底崩溃。
chunks.ex_en: Losing his keys was the last thing that broke the camel's back.
chunks.ex_cn: 弄丢钥匙成了压垮他的最后一根稻草。

chunks.head: break one's heart
chunks.gloss: 使某人心碎；让某人极度伤心
chunks.note: 指因失望、失去或悲伤而深受打击。
chunks.ex_en: It broke her heart to see the puppy left alone.
chunks.ex_cn: 看到小狗被独自丢下，她的心都碎了。

chunks.head: play hookey
chunks.note: 美式口语，指未经允许不去上学。
chunks.ex_en: The boys decided to play hookey and go swimming.
chunks.ex_cn: 男孩们决定逃学去游泳。

chunks.head: over and over again
chunks.note: 强调动作多次重复。
chunks.ex_en: He read the letter over and over again.
chunks.ex_cn: 他把那封信读了一遍又一遍。

chunks.head: by and by
chunks.note: 略显old-fashioned的说法，意为过一段时间之后。

literal.note_cn: 单独无实义，须整体记忆

chunks.ex_en: By and by, the rain stopped and the sun came out.
chunks.ex_cn: 过了一会儿，雨停了，太阳出来了。

chunks.head: take someone aside
chunks.gloss: 把某人拉到一边(单独谈话)
chunks.note: 指把某人单独带开以便私下说话。
chunks.ex_en: The coach took me aside to explain my mistake.
chunks.ex_cn: 教练把我拉到一边，解释我的错误。

chunks.head: go on doing
chunks.note: go on + 动名词，表示不停地、继续地做某事。
chunks.ex_en: She went on talking as if nothing had happened.
chunks.ex_cn: 她继续说着，仿佛什么都没发生。

chunks.head: go back on
chunks.note: 指不遵守承诺或出卖、背叛某人。
chunks.ex_en: A good friend never goes back on a promise.
chunks.ex_cn: 真正的朋友绝不会违背承诺。

chunks.head: in keeping with
chunks.note: 表示与某事物相协调、相符合。
chunks.ex_en: The new building is in keeping with the old town's style.
chunks.ex_cn: 这座新楼与老城的风格很协调。

chunks.head: one's heart sinks
chunks.note: 指突然感到失望、害怕或气馁。

literal.note_cn: sink的过去式，此处喻心情低落

chunks.ex_en: My heart sank when I saw the test results.
chunks.ex_cn: 看到考试成绩，我的心一沉。

chunks.head: a goner
chunks.gloss: 没救了的人；完蛋的家伙
chunks.note: 口语，指注定要死、失败或无可挽回的人或物。
chunks.ex_en: If the boss finds out, I'm a goner.
chunks.ex_cn: 要是被老板发现，我就完蛋了。

chunks.head: can't stand
chunks.note: stand 此处意为“忍受”；常用于讨厌或难以承受的事物。
chunks.ex_en: I can't stand the noise of the traffic at night.
chunks.ex_cn: 我受不了夜里的车流噪音。

chunks.head: on and on
chunks.note: 表示动作或状态长时间持续。
chunks.ex_en: The teacher talked on and on until the bell rang.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师不停地讲，直到铃响。

chunks.head: over one's shoulder
chunks.note: 常与 look/glance 连用，表示回头张望。
chunks.ex_en: She glanced over her shoulder to see who was following.
chunks.ex_cn: 她回头看了一眼，想知道谁在跟着。

chunks.head: break down
chunks.note: 本章指人体力不支、支撑不住。也可指机器坏了或情绪崩溃。
chunks.ex_en: Our car broke down on the way to the beach.
chunks.ex_cn: 去海边的路上，我们的车抛锚了。

chunks.head: get off
chunks.note: 本章意为逃脱麻烦、不受惩罚。另有“下车”等常见义。
chunks.ex_en: He was lucky to get off with just a warning.
chunks.ex_cn: 他很走运，只受了个警告就脱身了。

chunks.head: in time
chunks.gloss: 最终；渐渐地(经过一段时间后)
chunks.note: 本章意为“经过一段时间后、终于”；另一常见义是“来得及、及时”。
chunks.ex_en: Don't worry—in time, you'll understand why.
chunks.ex_cn: 别担心，慢慢地你就会明白为什么。

chunks.head: it's no use doing
chunks.note: 常接动名词或 for sb to do，表示某事白费力气。
chunks.ex_en: It's no use crying over spilt milk.
chunks.ex_cn: 覆水难收，哭也没用。
occ: no use for her to try

chunks.head: take and
chunks.note: take and + 动词 = 地方话强调式,重点在'就这么去做',take 不表'拿'。此处「take and belt him」=干脆抽他一下、「take and swear」=(郑重)立誓(血誓保密的正式场面)。同族:up and + 动词。
chunks.ex_en: I'll just take and tell him myself.
chunks.ex_cn: 我干脆自己去告诉他。
